feat.name: Ace Pilot
entries: You're quite experienced both on land and in the air, be it from time in a navy, as a mercenary, or perhaps even piracy. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain proficiency in the {@skill Piloting|sw5e-phb} skill. If you are already proficient in it, you instead gain {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in it.

Whenever you make an Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|sw5e-phb}) or Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) check related to vehicles or ships, you are considered to have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in the {@skill Investigation|sw5e-phb} or {@skill Perception|sw5e-phb} skill.

feat.name: Acrobat
entries: You become more nimble, gaining the following benefits:

items: Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain proficiency in the {@skill Acrobatics|sw5e-phb} skill. If you are already proficient in it, you instead gain {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in it.

As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can make a DC 15 Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics|sw5e-phb}) check. If you succeed, {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|sw5e-phb|difficult terrain} doesn't cost you extra movement until the end of the current turn.

feat.name: Actor
entries: Skilled at mimicry and dramatics, you gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Charisma ({@skill Deception|sw5e-phb}) and Charisma ({@skill Performance|sw5e-phb}) checks when trying to pass yourself off as a different person.

You can mimic the speech of another person or the sounds made by other creatures. You must have heard the person speaking, or heard the creature make the sound, for at least 1 minute. A successful Wisdom ({@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}) check contested by your Charisma ({@skill Deception|sw5e-phb}) check allows a listener to determine that the effect is faked.

feat.name: Alert
entries: Always on the lookout for danger, you gain the following benefits:

items: You are proficient in {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb} checks..
You can't be surprised while you are conscious.
Other creatures don't gain {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} against you as a result of being unseen by you.

feat.name: Animal Handler
entries: You master the techniques needed to train and handle animals. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain proficiency in the {@skill Animal Handling|sw5e-phb} skill. If you are already proficient in it, you instead gain {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in it.

You can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} on your turn to command one friendly beast within 60 feet of you that can hear you and that isn't currently following the command of someone else. You decide now what action the beast will take and where it will move during its next turn, or you issue a general command that lasts for 1 minute, such as to guard a particular area.

feat.name: Armor Expert
entries: You've learned how to fluidly move in armor, gaining the following benefits:

items: Increase your Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You gain proficiency with {@filter light armor|items|type=light armor}. If you are already proficient with {@filter light armor|items|type=light armor}, instead while you are wearing {@filter light armor|items|type=light armor}, your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} increases by 5 feet.

If you are already proficient in {@filter light armor|items|type=light armor} when you take this feat, you also gain proficiency in {@filter medium armor|items|type=medium armor}. If you are already proficient with {@filter medium armor|items|type=medium armor}, instead while you are wearing {@filter medium armor|items|type=medium armor}, you can add 3, rather than 2, to your AC if you have a Dexterity of 16 or higher, and you ignore the bulky property of {@filter medium armor|items|type=medium armor}.

If you are already proficient in {@filter medium armor|items|type=medium armor} when you take this feat, you also gain proficiency in {@filter heavy armor|items|type=heavy armor}. If you are already proficient with {@filter heavy armor|items|type=heavy armor}, instead while you are wearing {@filter heavy armor|items|type=heavy armor}, critical hits made against you are treated as normal hits.

entries: You can take this feat multiple times.

feat.name: Athlete
entries: You have undergone extensive physical training to gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
When you are {@condition Prone|sw5e-phb|prone}, standing up uses only 5 feet of your movement.
Climbing doesn't cost you extra movement.
You can make a running long jump or a running high jump after moving only 5 feet on foot, rather than 10 feet.

feat.name: Battle Scarred
entries: You've spent a lifetime fighting, with the scars to prove it. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
When you roll a 19 or a 20 on the {@dice d20} for a {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|death saving throw}, you regain 1 hit point.

When you are reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead. Once you've used this ability, you must complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

feat.name: Bountiful Luck
entries: Your people have extraordinary luck, which you have learned to lend to your companions when you see them falter. You're not sure how you do it; you just wish it, and it happens. Surely a sign of fortune's favor!

When an ally you can see within 30 feet of you rolls a 1 on the {@dice d20} for an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, or a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} and expend 1 luck point to let the ally reroll the die. The ally must use the new roll. When you use this ability, you can't use luck points before the end of your next turn.

feat.name: Brawny
entries: You become stronger, gaining the following benefits:

items: Increase your Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain proficiency in the {@skill Athletics|sw5e-phb} skill. If you are already proficient in it, you instead gain {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in it.
Your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift doubles. If it would already double, it instead triples.

feat.name: Charmer
entries: You've master the art of charming those around you, gaining the following benefits:

items: Increase your Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain proficiency in the {@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb} skill. If you are already proficient in it, you instead gain {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in it.

If you spend 1 minute talking to someone who can understand what you say, you can make a Charisma ({@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb}) check contested by the creature's Wisdom ({@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}) check. If you or your companions are fighting the creature, your check automatically fails. If your check succeeds, the target is {@condition Charmed|sw5e-phb|charmed} by you as long as it remains within 60 feet of you and for 1 minute thereafter.

feat.name: Climber
entries: You excel at scaling cliffsides, hills, trees, and general climbing. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain a climbing {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} equal to your movement {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}.

You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability checks} and {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} to avoid falling off or down while climbing.

You can spend 5 minutes instructing, pointing out handholds, and guiding other creatures before making a climb. When you do so, choose up to six friendly creatures (which can include yourself) within 30 feet of you. Each creature can add a 1d6 to any {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} they make for that climb.

feat.name: Commando
entries: You've {@feat Practiced|sw5e-phb|practiced} fighting while {@condition Prone|sw5e-phb|prone}, gaining the following benefits:

items: Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain a crawling {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} equal to your movement {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}.
While prone, you no longer have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on ranged {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} against targets within 30 feet due to being prone.

When you attempt to hide on your turn while {@condition Prone|sw5e-phb|prone}, you can opt to not move on that turn. If you avoid moving, you are considered lightly obscured. You lose this benefit if you move or stand up, either voluntarily or because of some external effect. You are still automatically detected if any effect or action causes you to no longer be hidden. If you are still hidden on your next turn, you can continue to remain motionless and gain this benefit until you are detected.

feat.name: Competitor
entries: You have a strong aptitude for competing. Select one gaming set. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase an ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain proficiency in the chosen gaming set. If you are already proficient with it, you instead gain {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} with it.

As long as you spend at least 1 minute using your gaming set, you can't have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on Intelligence checks you make to use the gaming set, Charisma ({@skill Deception|sw5e-phb}) checks you make to bluff with the gaming set, or Wisdom ({@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}) checks you make to read an opponent with whom you are competing with the gaming set.

entries: You can take this feat multiple times. Each time you do so, you must choose a different gaming set.

feat.name: Crafter
entries: You have a knack for crafting; you work with greater efficiency and produce goods of higher quality. Select one type of artisan's implements. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase an ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain proficiency with the chosen tool. If you are already proficient with it, you instead gain {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} with it.

When you craft something with the chosen tool, the total market value you can craft increases 50 cr per day. If you have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} with it, the market value instead increases by 100 cr per day.
If you use the tool you've selected to practice a profession during downtime, you can support a lifestyle one higher than you would normally be able to.

entries: You can take this feat multiple times. Each time you do so, you must choose a different set of artisan's implements.

feat.name: Dungeon Delver
entries: Alert to the hidden traps and secret doors found in many dungeons, you gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Intelligence or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) and Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|sw5e-phb}) checks made to detect the presence of secret doors.
You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} made to avoid or resist traps.
You have resistance to the damage dealt by traps.
Traveling at a fast pace no longer imposes a -5 penalty to your passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) score.

feat.name: Durable
entries: Hardy and resilient, you gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

When you roll a Hit Die to regain {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, the minimum number of {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} you can regain from the roll equals twice your Constitution modifier (minimum of 2).

Your hit point maximum increases by an amount equal to twice your level when you gain this feat. Whenever you gain a level thereafter, your hit point maximum increases by an additional 2 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}.

feat.name: Empathic
entries: You possess keen insight into how other people think and feel. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain proficiency in the {@skill Insight|sw5e-phb} skill. If you are already proficient in it, you instead gain {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in it.

You can use your action to try to get uncanny insight about one humanoid you can see within 30 feet of you. Make a Wisdom ({@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}) check contested by the target's Charisma ({@skill Deception|sw5e-phb}) check. On a success, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} and {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability checks} against the target until the end of your next turn.

feat.name: Entertainer
entries: You have a natural gift for performing. Select one musical instrument. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase an ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain proficiency in the chosen musical instrument. If you are already proficient with it, you instead gain {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} with it.

While playing your chosen musical instrument, you can always readily read the emotions of those paying attention to you. During this time, and for up to one minute after completing, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}) checks to read the emotions of those you performed for.

entries: You can take this feat multiple times. Each time you do so, you must choose a different musical instrument.

feat.name: Fanatic
entries: Every blow that hits your enemies make you feel closer to victory, making you shake in excitement. You gain the following benefits:

items: When you score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-phb|critical hit} with an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} or reduce a creature to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, you can make one {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}.

Whenever a creature you can see within 30 feet is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, you go into a fervor gaining temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to 1d4 + your Constitution modifier.

feat.name: Feigned Confidence
entries: You've spent years pretending you know what you're doing, gaining the following benefits:

items: Increase your Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

When you would make an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} with a skill or tool that doesn't add your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}, you can first make a DC 15 Charisma ({@skill Deception|sw5e-phb}) check. On a success, you can add your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} to the initial {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}. You regain all expended uses when you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

feat.name: Fighting Master
entries: You've mastered a particular style of fighting. Choose one of the fighting mastery options, detailed later in this chapter. You can take this feat multiple times.

feat.name: Fighting Stylist
entries: You adopt a particular style of fighting as your specialty, gaining the following benefits:

items: Increase your Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Choose one of the fighting style options, detailed later in this chapter.

entries: You can take this feat multiple times.

feat.name: Force Guidance
entries: You've learned to utilize your gift with the Force in a specific, unique way. You gain the following benefits

items: Increase your Wisdom or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Choose a skill or tool in which you are proficient. When you make an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} with the chosen skill or tool, you can add half your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice, minimum of one) to the check if it doesn't already include that modifier. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}. You regain all expended uses when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries: You can take this feat multiple times. Each time you do so, you must choose a different skill or tool.

feat.name: Force of Personality
entries: Rooms never go unalerted to your presence, and the strength of your personality make others lose focus on their own social game. Powers and other effects infrequently override your force of will. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You can use your Charisma modifier instead of your Wisdom modifier when making {@skill Insight|sw5e-phb} checks.

When you would make a Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can instead make a Charisma {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}. You regain all expended uses of this feature when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

feat.name: Force-Sensitive
entries: You know two at-will {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}. When you reach 3rd level, you learn one 1st-level {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, which you can cast once per {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. When you reach 5th level, you learn one 2nd-level {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, which you can once per {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. Your {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} is Wisdom or Charisma (depending on power alignment). Additionally, you lose the Force-Insensitive special trait if you have it.

feat.name: Forceful Vigor
entries: Your strength and virility rarely go unnoticed, often to the point of distraction. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You can use your Strength modifier instead of your Constitution modifier when making Constitution checks.

When you would make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can instead make a Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}. You regain all expended uses of this feature when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

feat.name: Formfighting Dabbler
entries: You've dabbled in the basics of the known forms of lightsaber combat. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase an ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You learn one {@book lightsaber form|sw5e-phb|6|Lightsaber Forms}, detailed later in this chapter. If you already know at least one {@book lightsaber form|sw5e-phb|6|Lightsaber Forms}, you instead learn three {@book lightsaber forms|sw5e-phb|6|Lightsaber Forms}. If you already know at least three {@book lightsaber forms|sw5e-phb|6|Lightsaber Forms}, you instead learn seven {@book lightsaber forms|sw5e-phb|6|Lightsaber Forms}. If you already know at least ten {@book lightsaber forms|sw5e-phb|6|Lightsaber Forms}, you instead learn the remaining forms.

feat.name: Galvanizing Presence
entries: Your presence on the battlefield is a source of inspiration. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you let out a rallying war cry, ending the {@condition Frightened|sw5e-phb} or {@condition Charmed|sw5e-phb|charmed} condition on yourself and a number of allies that can hear you equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of one). Once you've used this ability, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

feat.name: Haggler
entries: Your skills at bartering have granted you the following benefits:

items: Increase your Charisma score by 1 up to a maximum of 20.
You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Charisma ({@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb}) and Charisma ({@skill Deception|sw5e-phb}) checks when attempting to barter or trade.
You are always aware of the current monetary value for any unenhanced or common enhanced item. Whenever you identify an item, you gain a rough estimate of its current monetary value.

feat.name: Healer
entries: You are an able medic, allowing you to mend wounds quickly and get your allies back in the fight. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Intelligence or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
When you use a {@item Traumakit|sw5e-phb|traumakit} to stabilize a dying creature, that creature also regains 1 hit point.

As an action, you can spend one use of a {@item Traumakit|sw5e-phb|traumakit} to tend to a creature and restore 1d6 + 4 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} to it, plus additional {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to the creature's maximum number of Hit Dice. The creature can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} again in this way until it finishes a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

feat.name: Inspiring Leader
entries: You can spend 10 minutes inspiring your companions, shoring up their resolve to fight. When you do so, choose up to six friendly creatures (which can include yourself) within 30 feet of you who can see or hear you and who can understand you. Each creature can gain temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to your level + your Charisma modifier. A creature can't gain temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} from this feat again until it has finished a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

feat.name: Investigator
entries: You have an eye for detail and can pick out the smallest clues. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain proficiency in the {@skill Investigation|sw5e-phb} skill. If you are already proficient in it, you instead gain {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in it.
You can take the {@action Search|sw5e-phb} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}.

feat.name: Keen Mind
entries: You have a mind that can track time, direction, and detail with uncanny precision. You gain the following benefits.

items: Increase your Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You always know which way is north.
You always know the number of hours left before the next sunrise or sunset.
You can accurately recall anything you have seen or heard within the past month.

feat.name: Linguist
entries: You have studied languages and codes, gaining the following benefits:

items: Increase your Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You learn three languages of your choice.

You can ably create written ciphers. Others can't decipher a code you create unless you teach them, they succeed on an Intelligence check (DC = your Intelligence score + your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}), or they use a power to decipher it.

feat.name: Loremaster
entries: Your study of history rewards you with the following benefits:

items: Increase your Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain proficiency in the {@skill Lore|sw5e-phb} skill. If you are already proficient in it, you instead gain {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in it.

When you take the {@action Help|sw5e-phb} action to aid another creature's {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, you can make a DC 15 Intelligence ({@skill Lore|sw5e-phb}) check. On a success, that creature's check gains a bonus equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}, as you share pertinent advice and historical examples. To receive this bonus, the creature must be able to understand what you're saying.

feat.name: Lucky
entries: You have inexplicable luck that seems to kick in at just the right moment.

You have 3 luck points. Whenever you make an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, or a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can spend one luck point to roll an additional {@dice d20}. You can choose to spend one of your luck points after you roll the die, but before the outcome is determined. You choose which of the d20s is used for the {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}.

You can also spend one luck point when an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} is made against you. Roll a {@dice d20}, and then choose whether the attack uses the attacker's roll or yours. If more than one creature spends a luck point to influence the outcome of a roll, the points cancel each other out; no additional dice are rolled.
You regain your expended luck points when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

feat.name: Mariner
entries: You've spent an exorbitant amount of time in water. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain a swimming {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} equal to your movement {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}.
You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on a {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability checks} and {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} related to swimming.
You can hold your breath for a number of minutes equal to 1 + twice your Constitution modifier.

feat.name: Medic
entries: You master the physician's arts, gaining the following benefits:

items: Increase your Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain proficiency in the {@skill Medicine|sw5e-phb} skill. If you are already proficient in it, you instead gain {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in it.

During a {@variantrule Short Rest|sw5e-phb|short rest}, you can clean and bind the wounds of up to six willing beasts and humanoids. Make a DC 15 Wisdom ({@skill Medicine|sw5e-phb}) check for each creature. On a success, if a creature spends a Hit Die during this rest, that creature can forgo the roll and instead regain the maximum number of {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} the die can restore. A creature can do so only once per rest, regardless of how many Hit Dice it spends.

feat.name: Mobile
entries: You are exceptionally speedy and agile. You gain the following benefits:

items: Your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} increases by 10 feet.
When you use the {@action Dash|sw5e-phb} action, {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|sw5e-phb|difficult terrain} doesn't cost you extra movement on that turn.
When you make a melee attack against a creature, you don't provoke {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attacks} from that creature for the rest of the turn, whether you hit or not.

feat.name: Naturalist
entries: Your extensive study of nature rewards you with the following benefits:

items: Increase your Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain proficiency in the {@skill Nature|sw5e-phb} skill. If you are already proficient in it, you instead gain {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in it.

You learn the {@i toxin scan} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}. You can cast it once, using supplies scavenged around you, without the use of a {@item Wristpad|sw5e-phb|wristpad} and without spending tech points, and you regain the ability to do so when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

feat.name: Observant
entries: Quick to notice details of your environment, you gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Intelligence or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
If you can see a creature's mouth while it is speaking a language you understand, you can interpret what it's saying by reading its lips.

You are considered to have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} when determining your passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) and passive Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|sw5e-phb}) scores.

feat.name: Perceptive
entries: You hone your senses until they become razor sharp. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain proficiency in the {@skill Perception|sw5e-phb} skill. If you are already proficient in it, you instead gain {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in it.
Being in a lightly obscured area doesn't impose {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on your Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks if you can both see and hear.

feat.name: Performer
entries: You master performance so that you can command any stage. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain proficiency in the {@skill Performance|sw5e-phb} skill. If you are already proficient in it, you instead gain {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in it.

While performing, you can try to distract one humanoid you can see who can see and hear you. Make a Charisma ({@skill Performance|sw5e-phb}) check contested by the humanoid's Wisdom ({@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}) check. If your check succeeds, you grab the humanoid's attention enough that it makes Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) and Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|sw5e-phb}) checks with {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} until you stop performing.

feat.name: Power Adept
entries: When you gain this feat, choose one of the following damage types: acid, cold, fire, force, lightning, or necrotic. Powers you cast ignore resistance to damage of the chosen type. In addition, when you roll damage for a power you cast that deals damage of that type, you can treat any 1 on a damage die as a 2.
You can take this feat multiple times. Each time you do so, you must choose a different damage type.

feat.name: Power Channeling
entries: Choose one from force- or tech-casting. You've learned to cast powers of the chosen type with greater deliberation. Choose a number of powers you know of 1st level or higher equal to half your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}. When you cast one of the chosen powers, you can choose to spend an additional minute casting the power for each level of the power. If you do so, the cost of the power is reduced by half the number of points. Casting a power in this way requires {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration} (explained in {@book chapter 10|sw5e-phb|10}). If your {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration} is broken, the power dissipates without taking effect.
Whenever you gain a level in a class with casting of the chosen type, you can replace one of the chosen powers with another power of 1st level or higher you know.

feat.name: Practiced
entries: You have acquired skills over your career, gaining the following benefits:

items: Increase an ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain proficiency in any combination of two skills or tools of your choice.

feat.name: Promising Commander
entries: You've trained relentless to lead your allies on the field of battle, gaining the following benefits:

items: Increase your Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

As an action, you can gain tactical insight. For one minute, once per turn you can utter a special command or warning whenever an ally you can see within 30 feet makes an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. This creature can add a {@dice d4} to the roll provided it can hear and understand you. A creature can only benefit from one such die at a time. Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

feat.name: Quick-Fingered
entries: Your nimble fingers and agility let you perform sleight of hand. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain proficiency in the Sleight of Hand skill. If you are already proficient in it, you instead gain {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in it.

As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can make a Dexterity ({@skill Sleight Of Hand|sw5e-phb}) check to plant something on someone else, conceal an object on a creature, lift a purse, or take something from a pocket.

feat.name: Quick-Witted
entries: Great ideas come to you naturally, often when your life depends on it. You always have a plan, or at least parts of it. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You can use your Intelligence modifier instead of your Dexterity modifier when making {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb} checks.

When you would make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can instead make an Intelligence {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}. You regain all expended uses of this feature when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

feat.name: Resilient
entries: Choose one ability score. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase the chosen ability score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain proficiency in {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} using the chosen ability.

feat.name: Shard Modification
entries: You are specially modified droid used to house a shard. Shards are sentient crystals native to the planet Orax, roughly a foot in length, that communicate with each other through pulses of light. While inhabiting a specialized droid host, shards are able to overcome the droid's inability to wield the Force, granting the following benefits:

items: Increase an ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You lose the Force-Insensitive special trait.

You can cast the {@i sense force} {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} once per day. Wisdom or Charisma (your choice) is your {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} for this power.

feat.name: Silver-Tongued
entries: You develop your conversational skill to better {@optfeature Deceive|sw5e-phb|deceive} others. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain proficiency in the {@skill Deception|sw5e-phb} skill. If you are already proficient in it, you instead gain {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in it.

When you take the {@action Attack|sw5e-phb} action, you can replace one attack with an attempt to {@optfeature Deceive|sw5e-phb|deceive} one humanoid you can see within 30 feet of you that can see and hear you. Make a Charisma ({@skill Deception|sw5e-phb}) check contested by the target's Wisdom ({@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}) check. If your check succeeds, your movement doesn't provoke {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attacks} from the target and your {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} against it have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}; both benefits last until the end of your next turn or until you use this ability on a different target. If your check fails, the target can't be deceived by you in this way for 1 hour.

feat.name: Snappy Interjection
entries: You've mastered a quick tongue to aid your allies. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Once per short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, when an ally makes an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} or a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can spend your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to give them {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the roll.

feat.name: Specialist
entries: You have focused training with a specific tool. Select one type of {@feat Specialist|sw5e-phb|specialist}'s kit. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase an ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain proficiency with the chosen kit. If you are already proficient with it, you instead gain {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} with it.

You can attempt {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability checks} with the chosen kit without the kit present, but you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on the check when you do so.

Whenever you make an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} with the chosen kit and you don't have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on the check, you can treat a {@dice d20} roll of 9 or lower as a 10, as long as you spend at least 1 minute on the check.

entries: You can take this feat multiple times. Each time you do so, you must choose a different {@feat Specialist|sw5e-phb|specialist}'s kit.

feat.name: Stealthy
entries: You know how best to hide, gaining the following benefits:

items: Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain proficiency in the {@skill Stealth|sw5e-phb} skill. If you are already proficient in it, you instead gain {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in it.
If you are hidden, you can move up to 10 feet in the open without revealing yourself if you end the move in a position where you're not clearly visible.

feat.name: Supreme Accuracy
entries: You have uncanny aim with attacks that rely on precision. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Dexterity, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Whenever you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} using Dexterity, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma you can reroll one of the dice once.

feat.name: Supreme Aptitude
entries: You have uncanny skill with a preternatural focus. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, or Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Whenever you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} using Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, or Intelligence you can reroll one of the dice once.

feat.name: Supreme Durability
entries: You have uncanny resilience of both body and mind. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Strength, Constitution, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Whenever you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} using Strength, Constitution, Wisdom, or Charisma you can reroll one of the dice once.

feat.name: Survivalist
entries: You master wilderness lore, gaining the following benefits:

items: Increase your Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain proficiency in the {@skill Survival|sw5e-phb} skill. If you are already proficient in it, you instead gain {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in it.

You learn the {@i alarm} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}. You can cast it once, using supplies scavenged around you, without the use of a {@item Wristpad|sw5e-phb|wristpad} and without spending tech points, and you regain the ability to do so when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

feat.name: Tech Dabbler
entries: You know two at-will {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}. When you reach 3rd level, you learn and can cast one 1st-level {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} once per {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. When you reach 5th level, you learn and can cast one 2nd-level {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} once per {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. Your {@book techcasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Techcasting Ability} is Intelligence. You require use of a {@item Wristpad|sw5e-phb|wristpad} for these powers. Additionally, you lose the Tech-Impaired special trait if you have it.

feat.name: Techie
entries: You master the theory and practice of technology, gaining the following benefits:

items: Increase your Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain proficiency in the {@skill Technology|sw5e-phb} skill. If you are already proficient in it, you instead gain {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in it.

You learn the {@i repair droid} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}. You can cast it once, using supplies scavenged around you, without the use of a {@item Wristpad|sw5e-phb|wristpad} and without spending tech points, and you regain the ability to do so when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

feat.name: Threatening
entries: You become fearsome to others, gaining the following benefits:

items: Increase your Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain proficiency in the {@skill Intimidation|sw5e-phb} skill. If you are already proficient in it, you instead gain {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in it.

When you take the {@action Attack|sw5e-phb} action, you can replace one attack with an attempt to demoralize one humanoid you can see within 30 feet of you that can see and hear you. Make a Charisma ({@skill Intimidation|sw5e-phb}) check contested by the target's Wisdom ({@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}) check. If your check succeeds, the target is {@condition Frightened|sw5e-phb} until the end of your next turn. If your check fails, the target can't be {@condition Frightened|sw5e-phb} by you in this way for 1 hour.

feat.name: Tough
entries: You have the blood of heroes flowing through your veins. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Whenever you take the {@action Dodge|sw5e-phb} action in combat, you can spend one Hit Die to heal yourself. Roll the die, add your Constitution modifier, and regain a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to the total (minimum of one).

feat.name: Weapon Expert
entries: You have {@feat Practiced|sw5e-phb|practiced} extensively with a variety of weapons, gaining the following benefits:

items: Increase your Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You gain proficiency with {@filter all blasters|items|firearm=true}. If you are already proficient with {@filter all blasters|items|firearm=true}, instead once per turn when you would roll weapon damage using a {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true}, you can choose to have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}.

You gain proficiency with {@filter all lightweapons|items|type=martial weapon|category=lightweapon}. If you are already proficient with {@filter all lightweapons|items|type=martial weapon|category=lightweapon}, instead once per turn when you would roll weapon damage using a {@filter lightweapon|items|type=martial weapon|category=lightweapon}, you can choose to have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}.

You gain proficiency with {@filter all vibroweapons|items|type=martial weapon}. If you are already proficient with {@filter all vibroweapons|items|type=martial weapon}, instead once per turn when you would roll weapon damage using a {@filter vibroweapon|items|type=martial weapon}, you can choose to have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}.

entries: You can take this feat twice.
